description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run. No code changes needed — just edit and push.

signal_window_gmt.note: Signals generated only within this window. Outside it, post nothing.

risk.note: Stop = entry - (stop_atr_multiplier × ATR14). Target = entry + (target_atr_multiplier × ATR14).

macro_kill_switches.note: Any kill-switch that fires halts ALL signals for the day.

vix_context.note: VIX 20-25: only HIGH confidence (5-6/6). VIX 25-30: raise bar AND note tighter sizing. VIX >30: kill-switch.

earnings.note: Tickers inside the blackout window are excluded and logged in the Slack footer.
